files.main.cpp:
#include <iostream>
class Balance{int a_{};public:void deposit(int n){a_=n;}int value()const{return a_;}};int main(){int n{};std::cin>>n;Balance b;b.deposit(n);b.deposit(2);std::cout<<b.value()<<'\n';}
